subject: Your event on Love Long Eaton — October Holiday Football Camp
text:
Hi Long Eaton United team,

We’ve added your October Holiday Football Camp, running from 27–29 October at Grange Park, to Love Long Eaton, our independent local guide to events and things to do in the town.

We’ve included the ages, times and a link to your Eventbrite booking page, along with the club crest from your event listing.

You can see the listing here:
https://www.lovelongeaton.com/events/october-holiday-football-camp-long-eaton-united-2026

Could you take a look and let us know if anything needs correcting, or if you’d prefer a different image?

The listing is free. If it’s useful, we’d appreciate you sharing the page with your followers to help more local people find the event.

Thanks,
The Love Long Eaton team

subject: Your event on Love Long Eaton — Photography Zero
text:
Hi Nick,

We’ve added your free Photography Zero workshop at Long Eaton Art Room on 29 November to Love Long Eaton, our independent local guide to events and things to do in the town.

We’ve included the session times, guidance about cameras and smartphones, and a link to your Eventbrite booking page. We’ve also used your Photography Zero banner.

You can see the listing here:
https://www.lovelongeaton.com/events/photography-zero-long-eaton-art-room-29-november-2026

Could you take a look and let us know if anything needs correcting, or if you’d prefer a different image?

One detail we’d like to check: the booking page mentions both Long Eaton and Nottingham city centre for the outdoor section. Could you confirm where that part of the workshop will take place?
